definitions.gloss: to survive; to narrowly escape death
definitions.explanation: To come through alive after an accident, illness, or disaster that might have been fatal. Almost always used in the set phrase {命|いのち}を{取|と}り{留|と}める (or {一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}める), with the survivor as the subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取|と}り{留|と}めた。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}めた。
examples.english: Thanks to the surgery, he pulled through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{奇跡的|きせきてき}→奇跡的：28181_kisekiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}めて⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: He was in an accident but miraculously survived and regained consciousness.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}める or ⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}める. Rarely used with other objects.

WATCH OUT:
- The subject is the person who survives, not the rescuer. "The doctor saved his life" is ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救|すく}った→救う：02063_sukuu⟧, not {取|と}り{留|と}めた

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}める (to survive, to have one's life saved)
- ⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}める (to barely survive — more formal/dramatic)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{留|と}めた (somehow managed to survive)

RELATED WORDS:
- とりとめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (rambling, incoherent — a separate, common expression from the same root)
- ⟦{九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}→九死に一生：18016_kyuushiniisshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to have a narrow escape from death)
